671:t_004:11.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「This girl is another loser in love... In other words, she's one of my kind.」

671:t_004:12.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Don't lump $$ランカ$$ in with scum like you on your own say-so!」

671:t_004:13.en:
$$シモン$$
「I won't let you use $$ランカ$$ for the ambitions of someone who tries to destroy everything out of jealousy and misdirected spite!」

671:t_004:14.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「It's too late now. Soon the mass outbreak of $$バアル$$ will begin the great collapse that destroys every universe.」

671:t_004:15.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「I will watch it happen, and cast my thoughts back to the days of love with $$アポロニアス#pilot$$, now so far away.」

671:t_005:1.en:
$$カイエン$$
「So they've sent out $$アルテア$$'s forces too!」

671:t_005:2.en:
$$ジン$$
「If they're coming at us, they must be absolutely sure they can beat us.」

671:t_005:3.en:
$$カグラ$$
「Quit screwing around! You call using a woman as your tool a trump card!?」

671:t_005:4.en:
$$ゼシカ$$
「We can't lose to a guy like that!」

671:t_005:5.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「For $$ランカ$$...! And for the sake of this universe, too!」

671:t_005:6.en:
$$アルト$$
「Hang on, $$ランカ$$! I'm coming to save you right now!」

671:t_005:7.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「It's pointless, Wingless. In this sealed labyrinth of love and hate, you will meet your end.」

671:t_005:8.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Bring it on! Don't let it end at talk, $$ミカゲ$$!」

671:t_005:9.en:
$$アマタ$$
「We won't let your hatred swallow us or the universe!」

671:t_006:1.en:
$$ランド$$
「Of course we are! If we beat you here, we can escape this cramped space!」

671:t_006:2.en:
$$セツコ$$
「We have a reason we must go on! We'll get past your hatred!」

671:t_006:3.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「A showdown with $$バアル$$, is it... How admirable of you.」

671:t_006:4.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「But even if you destroy that, a power like yours is no match for them.」

671:t_007:0.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Do you mean $$テンプティ$$ and the rest?」

671:t_007:2.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「$$御使い$$! You trample into my heart with muddy boots!」

671:t_007:3.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Hehehe... Not $$頭翅#pilot$$ but $$ミカゲ$$... You say you've closed your heart, but there's an opening somewhere, isn't there?」

671:t_007:4.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Or are you waiting for someone? Some beloved someone who'll save you from this place?」

671:t_007:6.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「In the end, you're all half-baked. You're beyond human, yet too much of the human is left in you.」

671:t_007:7.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Something like you has no business calling itself $$天翅$$. So the name $$堕天翅$$ suits you just fine.」

671:t_007:8.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「That's how you imprisoned $$アトランディア$$, where we lived, in the gap between dimensions!」

671:t_007:9.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「All we could do there was wait for our chance! For over a hundred million years, doing nothing but waiting!」

671:t_007:10.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「And then our comrades vanished one after another, until all that was left was my hatred...! Yes... hatred for you and for the world!」

671:t_007:11.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Aww... what a letdown. If you're caught up in something like that, your power can't amount to much.」

671:t_007:12.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Silence! Now that I hold the Wings of Darkness, I will destroy the Wingless, and then take my revenge on you!」

671:t_007:13.en:
$$アマタ$$
「So that's $$ミカゲ$$'s true goal...」

671:t_007:14.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「No way, no use! In the end you don't understand the truth, and your path to $$シンカ$$ is half-baked too!」

671:t_007:16.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「I came all this way to look, but it's no fun. Go play with the Earthlings in your little world.」

671:t_007:18.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Don't talk to me so casually. I'm not your sweet little $$ティティ$$-chan, you know.」

671:t_007:19.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「I am an $$御使い$$... $$楽しみのテンプティ$$. You guys could stand on your heads and still never beat me.」

671:t_007:20.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Is that how you get so arrogant and play the ruler of other species!」

671:t_007:21.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「I'm not playing anything. It's just a fact.」

671:t_007:23.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Bye-bye, Earthlings! Think you can beat a $$堕天翅$$ ruled by hatred~!?」

671:t_008:0.en:
$$シン$$
「That girl...! Did she come just to mock us!」

671:t_008:1.en:
$$宗介$$
「On top of that, she came and went freely in this space we can't escape, probably to show off her power.」

671:t_008:3.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Ha ha ha ha ha! Ha ha ha ha ha ha ha!」

671:t_008:5.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「I thank you, $$御使い$$! Thanks to you, my hatred has doubled!」

671:t_009:1.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「This hatred will destroy you... the world! Yes... everything!」

671:t_009:5.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Yeah. I felt your overflowing feelings... your soul.」

671:t_010:0.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「Hey, $$バサラ$$! What are you saying!」

671:t_010:1.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「He's a $$堕天翅$$, and he's trying to wrap the world in hatred!」

671:t_010:2.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Like I care. I just took his soul head on.」

671:t_010:3.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Besides, love and hate, joy and anger, sorrow and pleasure, they're all human emotions, aren't they!」

671:t_010:4.en:
$$バサラ$$
「And there's no good or bad about them!」

671:t_010:5.en:
$$アマタ$$
「I get what you mean, but...」

671:t_010:6.en:
$$カイエン$$
「He's holding us here because he wants to see the universe destroyed!」

671:t_010:7.en:
$$バサラ$$
「He'll fall apart before that happens.」

671:t_010:10.en:
$$セツコ$$
「More than hatred, more than anything, his heart is filled with sadness.」

671:t_010:11.en:
$$シルヴィア$$
「That's why he's trying to destroy even himself along with the world.」

671:t_010:12.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Silence, Wingless! You have no business trampling into my heart!」

671:t_010:13.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「These Wings of Darkness are a trio of love, hatred, and despair! Can you break this harmony!?」

671:t_011:2.en:
$$アルト$$
「The $$ＹＦ－２９$$'s wings are resonating... This is...」
